svg.title: Sprint 2 - Current and Proposed Data Model

g.text: Sprint 2 - Current and Proposed Data Model
- assignee must be a member of the project
- parent and child belong to the same project
Unique membership is enforced by using
the encoded userId as the subcollection
Contains only a user's name and username
plus normalized search fields. No email
or credentials are copied from Payload.
Existing Payload collections are inside "Current app".
Sprint 2 additions for issue #4 are Cloud Firestore documents.
Existing app users are referenced by their Payload string IDs.
